title: Elon Musk’s Grandiose Media Ambitions Are Now a Real Threat to Some Major Players
summary: SpaceX's IPO filing reveals ad revenue for X is still below what it was when Musk acquired Twitter, but it is growing again. Meanwhile, Grok is producing 2 billion AI videos per month, while SpaceX's nascent connectivity business threatens the likes of Comcast and AT&T.
